name: Survive the Haunted Town
desc:
Welcome to Haunted Town! You need to survive！
Enter a town. The town is haunted！
In the game, players can play the role of civilians or ghosts.

HOW TO PLAY:
👻Ghosts: Find civilians, destroy buildings and kill civilians.
🤠Civilians: Build and upgrade defense towers to resist the attacks of ghosts.

👍If you find the game interesting, please give us a thumbs up！👍
👍Thumbs up and a favorite for more quality updates!👍
